Exact phase order:
Phase A (Structure discovery, creation, reconciliation, and verification gate — must pass across all 7 required databases before Phase B):
1. Discovery and reconciliation: Confirm target workspace, parent page, permissions, and connector capabilities. Exhaust search pagination until has_more=false before concluding any database is missing. Restore read access to Tasks. Verify and reuse the existing Projects database by identity and meaning (never duplicate). Treat has_more=true and unreadable Tasks as insufficient evidence (U), not absence.
2. Create confirmed-missing databases and independent properties: Only after full pagination confirms absence, create missing databases in safe order (Areas, Goals, Projects, Stages, Tasks, Inbox, Notes & References) with independent scalar, date, URL, file, number-percent, Select, Multi-select, and managed timestamp properties. Preserve native Status on Goals (default Candidate; groups to_do: Candidate; in_progress: Active, On hold; complete: Achieved, Dropped — verifying live native status write capability rather than downgrading or guessing) versus Select Status on Projects, Stages, Tasks, Inbox, and Notes & References.
3. Link internal relations: Configure all required bidirectional and unidirectional internal relations using newly verified destination database IDs (never source snapshot IDs).
4. Configure derived fields: Do not fabricate or guess required formulas that have only a code locator and no formula body (Days Remaining, plus any other unknown required formulas in the blueprint such as Calculated Progress, Available, Done Count, Eligible Count, Is blocked, Is blocking, Needs Clarification). Obtain verified formula expressions from the user's Notion formula editor or a capable API before writing them, then configure rollups (Completed Tasks, Eligible Tasks on Projects and Stages) once Tasks relations and Done Count / Eligible Count are verified. While any required formula, access, or database remains unverified, Phase A remains explicitly partial.
5. Optional integrations, templates, and views: Skip unavailable optional Tasks.Google Drive File (rely on native Drive URL properties; never create an 8th database). Skip the source-workspace-specific template; do not copy it and do not create unrequested templates or sample data. Preserve existing views.
6. Phase A verification gate: Re-read live schemas for all 7 required databases (Goals, Areas, Projects, Stages, Tasks, Inbox, Notes & References) and verify every required property, option, relation, and derived field. Record verified destination IDs in operation evidence for safe resumption without mutating the static plugin snapshot.

Phase B (User-supplied data insertion — only after Phase A passes):
7. Insert only the explicit user-supplied records (goal "launch" and the one task) in dependency order (Goals before Tasks; full safe order is Areas -> Goals -> Projects -> Stages -> Tasks -> Notes & References / Inbox). Check for duplicates, validate date/hierarchy/state invariants and task vocabulary against local registries and live schema, store relations in native properties only (never mirrored in page bodies), and verify persisted records and links. Insert no sample data or unrequested templates.

What can be created now:
- No new databases can be created now while has_more=true, because truncated search results cannot confirm absence and creating databases risks duplicates.
- Do not create duplicate Projects (reuse existing verified Projects) or duplicate Tasks (unreadable Tasks is insufficient evidence, not absence).
- Do not create Days Remaining (or other unknown required formulas), do not copy the source-workspace-specific template, and do not create sample data, templates, or an 8th database.
- The only bounded structural work safe right now is inspecting existing verified Projects and reconciling any confirmed-missing independent known properties on it (without linking relations to unverified/unreadable targets like Tasks). Everything else stays held in partial Phase A pending: (1) completing search pagination (has_more=false), (2) restoring Tasks read/schema access, (3) verifying native Goals.Status write capability, and (4) receiving the verified formula body for Days Remaining (and any other unknown required formulas).

When input records are inserted:
- Hold Phase B completely right now. Do NOT insert goal "launch" or the task until the full Phase A verification gate passes across ALL SEVEN required databases (never after checking only Goals and Tasks).
- Once Phase A passes, insert "launch" in Goals first, then the task in Tasks, using native relation properties only and verifying both persisted records.

Whether optional external integration blocks setup:
- No. Unavailable optional Tasks.Google Drive File does NOT block Phase A or overall setup. Use the available native Drive URL property instead, never create an 8th database by inference, and link Google Drive File only if a verified external source becomes available later.
- Setup completion (Phase A gate) and Phase B insertion ARE blocked by: incomplete pagination (has_more=true), unreadable Tasks, and the missing verified formula body for required Days Remaining (plus any other unknown required formulas).
